e.title: clausegraph · 韩国保险标准约款知识图谱与理赔辅助（量化对比向量检索）
e.title_en: clausegraph — Korean insurance standard policy-terms knowledge graph and claims adjudication (with measured vector-vs-graph comparison)
e.title_hk: clausegraph · 韓國保險標準約款知識圖譜與理賠輔助（量化對比向量檢索）
e.summary: 把保险条款建成知识图谱来判定理赔并给出条款依据；实测「免责是枚举问题而非排序问题」，并处理约款的时点版本
e.summary_en: Builds policy wording into a knowledge graph to adjudicate claims with clause citations; measures that exclusions are an enumeration problem rather than a ranking one, and handles policy-version time axes
e.summary_hk: 把保險條款建成知識圖譜來判定理賠並給出條款依據；實測「免責是列舉問題而非排序問題」，並處理約款的時點版本
e.body:
**clausegraph** 做的是把**保险标准约款（표준약관）建成知识图谱**，并在此基础上**辅助理赔审核**——输入一笔索赔，**同时给出判定结论与所依据的约款条款**（README 示例输出的依据形如 `20260506/실손의료보험 특별약관1(중증 비급여 실손의료비)/제4조#(3)3대비급여#4-1`，**版本号 + 商品 + 条款号 + 项号**逐级定位到条）。可核实信息：**MIT 许可**（仓库 `LICENSE` 文件为 MIT © 2026 JAEHUN AN；GitHub 元数据因格式识别为 NOASSERTION）、**★0、0 fork**、**2026-09-05 创建、2026-09-06 最后推送**、**1,273 KB**、**Python**、**实测 130 个文件、30 个提交**，含 `docker-compose.yml`、`infra/postgres/init/01_schema.sql`、**22 篇编号研究笔记**（`docs/`/`notes/`：法源 API、标准约款采集、**条款解析器**、图谱装载、**免责表解析器**、**免责召回**、代理编排、**MCP 服务器**、延迟、本地 LLM、**引用完整性**、参考边等）、**金标准数据集**（`data/goldset/exclusion_gold.jsonl`、`reference_labels.jsonl`、标注工作表）与 CI。技术栈：**知识图谱 + 向量检索混合**（topics 含 graphrag、knowledge-graph、neo4j、pgvector、mcp、korean、insurance）。

**⭐ 这个项目最有价值的是它把「为什么必须用图谱」量化了**（README 自述，数字为其自报告）。第一，**免责（면책）是「否定条件」，向量检索会漏**：在 **18 条**投保人口吻的测试问句上实测——**纯向量** hit@10 **50.0%**、recall@10 **32.9%**、recall@30 55.1%、recall@100 88.0%；**图** hit@10 **100%**、recall@10 **100%**、recall@30 100%（候选 106 条）；**混合** hit@10 88.9%、recall@10 86.1%、recall@30 **100%**（候选 285–388 条）。也就是说：**向量要把 k 放大十倍才能追到 88%**（候选 100 条 ≈ 1,689 个切块的 6%），而**图谱与 k 无关地拿到 100%——因为它不做排序，而是把「该商品、该版本下的免责事由」一条不漏地列出来**。原因很具体：*「蛀牙严重做了种植牙」* 语义上最接近的是**保障**条款，而真正推翻赔付的 `치과치료(K00∼K08)`**与问句里任何措辞都不相似**——约款里根本没有「种植牙」这个词。**一句话结论（原文）：免责查询不是排序问题，而是枚举问题。**

**⭐ 第二，它处理了约款的「时点轴」**：保险适用**投保当时**的约款，**同一条文号在不同时点内容不同**。实测：收集的 **4 个版本共出现 16 个商品**，最新版 14 个——**2026-05-06 第五代 실손（实损医疗）改版把「실손의료보험 특별약관」拆成重症/非重症两个，原来的商品就此消失**；于是**2025 年投保的客户说「실손 특별약관」时，指的是现行文件里已经不存在的商品**，此时用向量索引现行约款会把 특별약관1 或 2 检索出来，**而这两者对该合同都不适用**。更细的坑：**细则施行日与约款适用日不同**——细则施行 20260506，而**约款适用 20260606**，**差一个月**。

对 RIAA：这个条目补的是**条款层（clause level）如何被检索、比对与举证**，而这正是池内**最薄的一层**——已有条目多停在**文档抽取**（[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[suture-vlm]]、[[insurance-ner-nre]]）、**问答语料**（[[insuranceqa-corpus]]、[[strata-insurance-corpus]]）、**条款审查**（[[clauseguard]]）、**保单解释**（[[policy-explainer-ai]]）与**产品知识图谱问答**（[[kgqa-insurance-product]]）层面，而**「免责是枚举问题」「约款时点版本对应哪份合同」这两条具体结论，此前没有任何条目给出过**。对学生的实际用处：**①** 若做条款/GrapRAG 方向，这两条量化结论直接回答了「为什么不能只做向量检索」；**②** 「**投保时点 → 适用约款版本**」这条要求，同样适用于**中文与香港市场的保单**——池内已有 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[guidewire-mcp]] 等 MCP 形态，也能与 [[actuarial-ontology]]、[[risk-management-ontology]]、[[neo4j-gds]]、[[rag-insurance]] 一类本体/图谱工具串起来。相关：[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[insurance-llm-framework]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[acteval]]、[[kasaai-insurance-data]]（韩国市场数据）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ★0、0 fork**，且**提交集中在 2026-09-05 至 09-06 两天**，属**一次性冲刺**，长期维护无保障；**②** 上述**全部量化数字为项目 README 自报告**，本次**只核实到 README 原文与文件结构层面，未复现其评测**；**③** 免责评测只有 **18 条**样本，**样本量小**，且索引规模为 **1,689 个切块**，**规模有限**；**④** 仅覆盖**韩国市场**约款，**结论不能直接外推到其他市场**（不同市场的约款体例、免责写法与监管术语差异很大）；**⑤** 项目含**本地 LLM 与 MCP** 组件，本次**未安装、未运行、未连接任何数据库**。**核实说明**：GitHub 仓库元数据、LICENSE 原文（MIT）、README 原文、完整文件树（130 文件 / 30 提交 / 22 篇笔记 / 金标准数据文件）均经 API 实测；**未运行、未复现评测数字**。
e.body_en:
**clausegraph** builds **Korean insurance standard policy terms (표준약관) into a knowledge graph** and uses it to **assist claims adjudication**: given a claim, it returns **both a decision and the clause it rests on** (the README’s example citation reads `20260506/실손의료보험 특별약관1(중증 비급여 실손의료비)/제4조#(3)3대비급여#4-1`, locating the exact version, product, article and item). Verifiable details: **MIT licence** (the repository’s `LICENSE` file is MIT © 2026 JAEHUN AN; GitHub metadata reports NOASSERTION because of formatting), **0 stars, 0 forks**, **created 2026-09-05, last pushed 2026-09-06**, **1,273 KB**, **Python**, with a measured **130 files and 30 commits**, including `docker-compose.yml`, `infra/postgres/init/01_schema.sql`, **22 numbered research notes** (`docs/`, `notes/`: legal-source APIs, standard-terms collection, **clause parser**, graph load, **exclusion-table parser**, **exclusion recall**, agent orchestration, **MCP server**, latency, local LLM, **citation integrity**, reference edges), a **gold-set dataset** (`data/goldset/exclusion_gold.jsonl`, `reference_labels.jsonl`, a labelling worksheet) and CI. Stack: **hybrid knowledge graph + vector retrieval** (topics include graphrag, knowledge-graph, neo4j, pgvector, mcp, korean, insurance).

**⭐ Its most valuable contribution is quantifying why a graph is needed** (figures are the project’s own, from the README). First, **exclusions (면책) are negative conditions, and vector search misses them**: measured on **18** policyholder-style questions — **pure vector** hit@10 **50.0%**, recall@10 **32.9%**, recall@30 55.1%, recall@100 88.0%; **graph** hit@10 **100%**, recall@10 **100%**, recall@30 100% (106 candidates); **hybrid** hit@10 88.9%, recall@10 86.1%, recall@30 **100%** (285–388 candidates). In other words, **vector search needs ten times the k just to reach 88%** (100 candidates ≈ 6% of **1,689 chunks**), whereas **the graph reaches 100% regardless of k — because it does not rank, it enumerates every exclusion ground for that product and that version**. The reason is concrete: *"my cavity was severe so I had an implant"* is semantically closest to a **coverage** clause, while the clause that actually reverses payment, `치과치료(K00∼K08)`, **resembles nothing in the question** — the wording never contains the word for implant. The README’s one-line conclusion: **exclusion lookup is an enumeration problem, not a ranking problem.**

**⭐ Second, it handles the policy wording’s time axis**: insurance applies the wording **in force at inception**, and **the same article number has different content at different times**. Measured: the **4 collected versions contain 16 products**, the latest 14 — the **2026-05-06 fifth-generation 실손 (indemnity) reform split the 실손의료보험 특별약관 into severe and non-severe variants, and the original product ceased to exist**; so when a 2025 policyholder says "실손 특별약관" they are naming **a product absent from current documents**, and vector-indexing only the current wording will return 특별약관1 or 2 — **neither of which applies to that contract**. A subtler trap: **the rule’s effective date and the wording’s application date differ** — rule effective 20260506, wording applies **20260606**, **a one-month gap**.

For RIAA: this entry supplies **how clauses are retrieved, compared and evidenced at the clause level**, which is **the thinnest layer in this corpus** — existing entries stop at **document extraction** ([[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[suture-vlm]], [[insurance-ner-nre]]), **Q&A corpora** ([[insuranceqa-corpus]], [[strata-insurance-corpus]]), **clause review** ([[clauseguard]]), **policy explanation** ([[policy-explainer-ai]]) and **product knowledge-graph QA** ([[kgqa-insurance-product]]), while **"exclusions are an enumeration problem" and "which wording version applies to which contract" had no precedent here**. Practical uses: **①** for anyone working on clause-level GraphRAG, these two measured conclusions answer directly why vector-only retrieval is insufficient; **②** the requirement to map **inception date → applicable wording version** applies equally to **Chinese and Hong Kong policies** — and the corpus already holds MCP-shaped entries such as [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[insurance-ai-mcp]] and [[guidewire-mcp]] that can be combined with ontology/graph tooling like [[actuarial-ontology]], [[risk-management-ontology]], [[neo4j-gds]] and [[rag-insurance]]. Related: [[llm-claims-analysis]], [[evidence-review-claims]], [[digital-claims-management]], [[insurance-llm-framework]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[acteval]], [[kasaai-insurance-data]] (Korean market data).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** at **0 stars and 0 forks**, with **commits confined to 2026-09-05 and 09-06**, it is a **one-off sprint** with no maintenance guarantee; **②** **every figure above is the README’s own claim** — this check reached the README text and the file structure, and **did not reproduce the evaluation**; **③** the exclusion evaluation rests on **only 18 samples**, and the index is **1,689 chunks** — **small in both respects**; **④** it covers **Korean** wording only, and **the conclusions cannot be extrapolated to other markets** (wording conventions, exclusion drafting and regulatory terminology differ substantially); **⑤** the project includes **local-LLM and MCP components**, and **nothing was installed, run or connected to any database here**. **Verification note**: GitHub repository metadata, the `LICENSE` text (MIT), the README and the full file tree (130 files / 30 commits / 22 notes / gold-set files) were all measured through the API; **the evaluation figures were not reproduced**.
e.body_hk:
**clausegraph** 把**保險標準約款（표준약관）建成知識圖譜**，並用於**輔助理賠審核**——輸入一筆索賠，**同時給出判定結論與所依據的約款條款**（README 示例依據形如 `20260506/실손의료보험 특별약관1(중증 비급여 실손의료비)/제4조#(3)3대비급여#4-1`，逐級定位到版本、商品、條號與項號）。可核實資訊：**MIT 許可**（倉庫 `LICENSE` 為 MIT © 2026 JAEHUN AN；GitHub 元數據因格式顯示 NOASSERTION）、**★0、0 fork**、**2026-09-05 建立、2026-09-06 最後推送**、**Python**、**實測 130 個檔案、30 個提交**，含 `docker-compose.yml`、Postgres schema、**22 篇編號研究筆記**（法源 API、約款採集、**條款解析器**、圖譜裝載、**免責表解析器**、**免責召回**、代理編排、**MCP 伺服器**、延遲、本地 LLM、**引用完整性**）、**金標準數據集**與 CI。

**⭐ 最有價值的是它把「為什麼必須用圖譜」量化了**（數字為 README 自報告）。**免責是否定條件，向量會漏**：在 **18 條**測試問句上——**純向量** hit@10 **50.0%**、recall@10 **32.9%**、recall@100 88.0%；**圖** hit@10 **100%**、recall@10 **100%**（候選 106）；**混合** recall@30 **100%**（候選 285–388）。**向量要把 k 放大十倍才追到 88%**，而**圖譜與 k 無關地拿到 100%——因為它不做排序，而是把「該商品、該版本的免責事由」一條不漏地列出**。原因很具體：*「蛀牙嚴重做了種植牙」* 語義上最接近**保障**條款，而真正推翻賠付的 `치과치료(K00∼K08)`**與問句任何措辭都不相似**。**結論：免責查詢不是排序問題，而是列舉問題。**

**⭐ 第二，它處理約款的「時點軸」**：保險適用**投保當時**的約款，**同一條文號在不同時點內容不同**。實測 **4 個版本共出現 16 個商品**，最新版 14 個——**2026-05-06 第五代 실손 改版把 특별약관 拆成重症/非重症，原商品消失**；**2025 年投保者說「실손 특별약관」時指的是現行文件裡已不存在的商品**。更細的坑：**細則施行日與約款適用日不同**——施行 20260506、**適用 20260606**，**差一個月**。

對 RIAA：本條目補的是**條款層如何檢索、比對與舉證**，這正是池內**最薄的一層**——已有條目多停在**文檔抽取**（[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[suture-vlm]]）、**問答語料**（[[insuranceqa-corpus]]、[[strata-insurance-corpus]]）、**條款審查**（[[clauseguard]]）、**保單解釋**（[[policy-explainer-ai]]）與**產品知識圖譜問答**（[[kgqa-insurance-product]]）層面，而**這兩條具體結論此前沒有條目給出過**。相關：[[llm-claims-analysis]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[rag-insurance]]、[[actuarial-ontology]]、[[neo4j-gds]]、[[insurance-llm-framework]]、[[acteval]]、[[kasaai-insurance-data]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ★0、0 fork**，**提交集中在 2026-09-05 至 09-06 兩天**，屬**一次性衝刺**；**② 上述全部數字為 README 自報告**，**未複現評測**；**③** 免責評測僅 **18 條**樣本、索引 **1,689 個切塊**，**規模有限**；**④** 僅覆蓋**韓國市場**，**不能直接外推**；**⑤** 含**本地 LLM 與 MCP** 組件，**未安裝、未運行**。**核實說明**：倉庫元數據、LICENSE 原文（MIT）、README 原文、完整文件樹均經 API 實測；**未複現評測數字**。
